content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CIFA Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the ICAR CIFA recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the ICAR CIFA recruitment is Young Professional-II. This is a contract-based position for research purposes.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Young Professional-II post announced by ICAR CIFA.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate degree in a professional course (M.F.Sc with 4 years Bachelor's + 2 years Master's in Fish Biotechnology) or M.Sc. in Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Zoology, Biochemistry, or Genomics from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The age limit for this position is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Interested candidates need to attend the walk-in interview with all required documents on the specified date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Central Institute of Freshwater Aquaculture (ICAR CIFA), Bhubaneswar, Odisha, 751002.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their Bio-Data (5 Copies), two passport size photographs, and self-attested copies of all certificates and mark sheets. Original certificates are also required for verification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
